name: 自适应控制公式方向与文字意图相反
trigger: adaptive parameter formula is monotone in the opposite direction from the stated diversity/convergence/error response
example: S043 Pmutation=Pbase+alpha(1-ConvergenceRate) decreases as convergence rises, while prose says low diversity should increase mutation
gate: symbolically/monotonicity-test adaptive formulas at low/mid/high state values before trusting the label
